name: Mournful Cry (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Ability drain, or energy drain, Cha 13

Benefit(s): Once per day as a swift action you can affect all living creatures within a 30-foot radius burst with the effects of your ability drain or energy drain attack. A successful Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your Hit Dice + your Charisma modifier) halves the number of ability points drained or the number of negative levels inflicted.
